SR2E.Clinic99.recordFull: {owner}'s ware fills that character's share of the damage record ({max} entries): further damage to their ware isn't recorded until some is cleared (the Clinics and ware damage tool).
SR2E.Clinic99.cameBack: {owner} deleted their {item} while it had {level} damage in the record: the new {item} keeps that level (clear it with the tool if it is really new).
SR2E.Clinic99.untickRefused: {name} stays installed: under the book's removal rule the GM takes cyberware out (Clinics and ware damage tool, Remove cyberware).
SR2E.Clinic99.untickGm: {name} is taken out without the removal test (the book's way is the Clinics and ware damage tool, Remove cyberware).
SR2E.Clinic99.notInNow: {name} is no longer installed: nothing removed.
SR2E.Clinic99.clearUsed: That clear card (or the repair test it names) has already cleared a damage record.
SR2E.Clinic99.noRepairProof: No repair test backs this card: its repair card is missing, by someone else, of other ware, without successes at the damage level's target number, or already used.
SR2E.Clinic99.clearProof: Repair test by {roller}: successes {successes} at TN {tn}
SR2E.Clinic99.alreadyIn: {name} is already installed: remove it first (the GM's Clinics and ware damage tool) for another operation.
